description: Check a website the way an AI agent meets it: robots.txt and content signals, sitemap, Markdown on request, llms.txt, the API catalog, OAuth discovery, an MCP server card, agent skills, an A2A card, and whether the home page lets an agent in. Each file is checked by its body against an address that cannot exist, so a site that answers every path with its home page is reported as a false pass instead of a pass.

api_key.description: Your key (sik_…), only if your MCP client cannot send it as the Authorization header, for example a key you just got from request_key. The header wins when both are sent.

url.description: The site to check, e.g. example.com

name: check_agent_readiness
title: Check whether AI agents can use a website
